title: CP16 Unknown Mass by Resonance Core Practical
description: Edexcel IAL Physics core practical 16: find an unknown mass from the resonant frequencies of known masses on a spring. Turn the signal generator to the largest amplitude yourself, plot f₀ against 1/√m and read the unknown mass off the line.
